overview: Ultra-modern, editorial-style luxury real estate website for Abode Properties (Indore). A premium property consultancy brand experience — cinematic hero, immersive property showcase, glassmorphism testimonials, interactive process timeline, and a contact inquiry form. Designed to feel like a luxury architecture magazine, not a broker portal.
features: Cinematic hero with slow-zoom animation and trust indicators
Horizontal-scroll editorial property showcase (Residential, Commercial, Retail, Investment)
Magazine-style asymmetric featured properties grid with hover effects
Interactive 4-step process timeline with animated connector
Warm gradient CTA section with consultation booking
Contact inquiry form with Motoko backend storage
